messages:
Jules (People Ops): Heads-up 100  new manager starts Mon 05/04. I'm putting together a compact 'Manager First Week' one-pager + a single-sheet 30/60/90. Can ppl confirm must-haves?

Maya (HR): Must include payroll ID checklist, benefits enrollment link, and note about probation review timeline. Also add manager training slot in week 2.

Sam (Eng Manager): Please include: required access list (repos, infra dashboards, OKR board), who signs 30/60/90 (I vote skip-level), and a short "first 7 days" tactical checklist: meet each direct, review last 3 retros, check on-call rota.

Carlos (IT): I'll pre-stage laptop + SSO. Common blockers: SCIM group sync and repo admin perms. Plan: create ticket now; if access delayed >2h ping @Carlos and use the triage Zoom link in the Day0 email.

Jules (People Ops): Draft 30/60/90 skeleton I plan to attach (one line per cell):
- 30d: Onboard team + deliver a small scoped customer/infra fix (metric: PR merged, deploy clear)
- 60d: Own an end-to-end feature or operational play (metric: feature milestone hit)
- 90d: Independently deliver & collect stakeholder feedback (metric: stakeholder NPS / delivery cadence improved)

Sam (Eng Manager): Suggest adding columns: Success metric, Blockers, Support needed, Sign-off. Keep it single page.

Maya (HR): Add buddy assignment and benefits deadline to Day0 email. Also confirm payroll setup by Day 3.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder scheduled: send Day -2 email 48h before start; send Day 0 agenda 24h before; schedule Week1 check-in.

Jules (People Ops): Escape-hatch plan: if blocked on access >2h, ping @Carlos + start IT triage via the link. Owners: Carlos=access, Maya=paperwork & buddy, Sam=team intros & 30/60/90 reviewer, Jules=calendar templates + final packet. I'll post the one-pager here by EOD. :party_parrot:
